name: Basilica of Saint Servatius
scope: Standing Maastricht basilica exterior, including the Romanesque westwork, Gothic southern chapels and Bergportaal, apsidal choir, and attached cloister and treasury ranges.
era: Present twin-spire exterior following the twentieth-century repair work, with modern Qualla photography and mapped footprint.

stories.title: Basilica of Saint Servatius: An Armenian Bishop's Grave in the Low Countries

references.caption: Basílica de San Servacio (Sint-Servaasbasiliek) en Maastricht, Países Bajos. Es una iglesia católica de estilo románico y gótico que ostenta el título de basílica menor.
references.alt: Basílica de San Servacio (Sint-Servaasbasiliek) en Maastricht, Países Bajos. Es una iglesia católica de estilo románico y gótico que ostenta el título de basílica menor.

originalReview.notes: July 2023 view confirms twin slate spires, stone bells and arcades, the tall glazed Bergportaal and three small arched lights, the adjoining tracery window, and the lower dark stone courses.

references.caption: Maastricht, S. Servaes Cathedral, floor plan.
references.alt: Maastricht, S. Servaes Cathedral, floor plan.
categories: Images from Die kirchliche Baukunst des Abendlandes by Dehio and Bezold

originalReview.notes: The historic published plan separates the westwork, nave arcade, projecting south entrance, square-ended transepts and semicircular apse. The current map governs built outlines and court range.

review.method: Exact Qualla originals, direct Commons and template provenance, Dutch government heritage measurements, basilica documentation and native mapped footprint
review.notes: The 2023 CC0 photograph and Dehio and von Bezold’s expired plate 47 were inspected as exact originals already published by Qualla. Photo and plan guide different parts of the exterior. Exterior heights and details absent from those references follow the archival written survey and are approximate.
